name: Open holds
description: The open Holds of a proposal's subject that the caller may see, newest first: each {hold, title, calendar, expires, slots: [{start, end, event}]}, so an agent reading a reply can tell which held time it picks and call choose. Args {subject: {entity, id}}.

outputs.description: What the proposals are about, {entity, id} (a mail thread, a conversation)

config.expr: {filter: {field: "status", op: "eq", value: "open"}, sort: [{field: "_createdAt", desc: true}], limit: 200}

nodes.title: Open Holds the caller may see
The subject's, in the tool's shape

config.expr: let e = string(subject?.entity ?? ""); let i = string(subject?.id ?? ""); map(filter(records ?? [], string(#.subject?.entity ?? "") == e && string(#.subject?.id ?? "") == i), ({hold: string(#._id), title: #.title ?? "", calendar: string(#.calendar ?? ""), expires: #.expires ?? "", slots: #.slots ?? []}))
